# Rules

## core

| Rule | Description | Severity | Category | Recommended | Fixable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`documented-outputs`](./documented-outputs.md) | Require every `output` block to have a `description`. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`documented-variables`](./documented-variables.md) | Require every `variable` block to have a `description`. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`module-source-pinned`](./module-source-pinned.md) | Require module sources to be pinned via `?ref=`, a `version` attribute, or a local path. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-bool-as-count`](./no-bool-as-count.md) | Flag a `count` meta-argument set to a boolean; Terraform 0.12 removed bool-to-number coercion. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-duplicate-map-keys`](./no-duplicate-map-keys.md) | Flag a repeated statically-known key in an object literal. HCL keeps only the last entry and silently discards the earlier ones. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-empty-list-equality`](./no-empty-list-equality.md) | Flag `==` or `!=` against an empty tuple literal `[]`, which never matches a list, set, or map value. Use `length(expr) == 0` instead. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-external-refs-in-destroy-provisioner`](./no-external-refs-in-destroy-provisioner.md) | Flag references to anything other than `self`, `count.index`, or `each.key`/`each.value` inside `provisioner` blocks with `when = destroy`. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-legacy-count-attribute`](./no-legacy-count-attribute.md) | Flag references to the legacy `.count` attribute of a resource, removed in Terraform 0.12. Use `length(...)` instead. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-dot-index`](./no-legacy-dot-index.md) | Flag legacy dot forms `list.0` and `a.*.b`. Use bracket index `list[0]` and full splat `a[*].b`. | warn | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-ignore-changes-wildcard`](./no-legacy-ignore-changes-wildcard.md) | Flag the quoted `["*"]` wildcard in a `lifecycle` `ignore_changes` list, replaced by the unquoted `all` keyword in Terraform 0.15. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-list-function`](./no-legacy-list-function.md) | Flag the legacy `list(...)` function, removed in Terraform 0.15. Use a `[...]` tuple literal instead. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-lookup`](./no-legacy-lookup.md) | Flag two-argument `lookup()`, deprecated since Terraform 0.7. Use index syntax instead. | warn | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-map-function`](./no-legacy-map-function.md) | Flag the legacy `map(...)` function, removed in Terraform 0.15, in favor of a `{ key = value }` object literal. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-provider-proxy`](./no-legacy-provider-proxy.md) | Flag empty `provider` blocks that exist only to declare an alias; replace with `configuration_aliases` in `required_providers`. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-provider-version-constraint`](./no-provider-version-constraint.md) | Flag a `version` argument inside a `provider` block; declare the version in `terraform.required_providers` instead. | warn | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-quoted-depends-on`](./no-quoted-depends-on.md) | Disallow quoted references in `depends_on`; use bare references. | warn | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-quoted-ignore-changes`](./no-quoted-ignore-changes.md) | Disallow quoted references in a `lifecycle` `ignore_changes` list; use bare attribute references. | warn | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-quoted-provider-reference`](./no-quoted-provider-reference.md) | Disallow quoted provider references in `provider` arguments and module `providers` maps; use a bare traversal. | warn | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-quoted-type-constraints`](./no-quoted-type-constraints.md) | Disallow quoted type constraints in `variable` blocks; use the unquoted type keyword. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-reserved-variable-names`](./no-reserved-variable-names.md) | Disallow `variable` blocks named after an OpenTofu reserved meta-argument. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-splat-bracket-index`](./no-splat-bracket-index.md) | Flag a constant index applied to a splat result, a pre-0.12 artifact; index the resource first instead. | warn | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-template-provider`](./no-template-provider.md) | Flag use of the archived `hashicorp/template` provider; prefer the built-in `templatefile()` function or the `cloudinit` provider. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`no-terraform-env-reference`](./no-terraform-env-reference.md) | Flag references to `terraform.env`, replaced by `terraform.workspace` since Terraform 0.10. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-winrm-connection`](./no-winrm-connection.md) | Flag `connection` blocks with `type = "winrm"`; winrm is deprecated in OpenTofu 1.12 and slated for removal in 1.13. Use `type = "ssh"`. | warn | core | ✔ |  |
| [`prefer-bare-expression`](./prefer-bare-expression.md) | Prefer the bare expression form over the redundant "${expr}" wrapping. | warn | core | ✔ |  |
| [`provider-source-required`](./provider-source-required.md) | Require every provider in `terraform.required_providers` to declare an explicit `source`. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`remote-state-outputs-prefix`](./remote-state-outputs-prefix.md) | Flag a `data.terraform_remote_state` reference that omits the required `.outputs.` prefix, required since Terraform 0.12. | error | core | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`required-providers-pinned`](./required-providers-pinned.md) | Require every provider in `terraform.required_providers` to declare a `version` constraint. | error | core | ✔ |  |
| [`required-version-declared`](./required-version-declared.md) | Require a `terraform` block that declares `required_providers` to also declare `required_version` somewhere in the same file. | warn | core | ✔ |  |
| [`typed-variables`](./typed-variables.md) | Require every `variable` block to declare a `type`. | error | core | ✔ |  |

## aws

| Rule | Description | Severity | Category | Recommended | Fixable |

| [`acm-certificate-create-before-destroy-required`](./acm-certificate-create-before-destroy-required.md) | Require `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on `aws_acm_certificate` so replacing an in-use certificate does not hang until timeout. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-api-gateway-deployment-stage-args`](./no-api-gateway-deployment-stage-args.md) | Flag `stage_name`, `stage_description`, and `canary_settings` on `aws_api_gateway_deployment`, removed in AWS provider v6; manage the stage with a separate `aws_api_gateway_stage` resource. | error | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-aurora-pinned-minor-with-auto-upgrade`](./no-aurora-pinned-minor-with-auto-upgrade.md) | Flag an Aurora PostgreSQL cluster that pins `engine_version` deeper than the auto minor upgrade enabled across its instances will hold stable, which drifts on every plan. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-db-instance-name-attribute`](./no-db-instance-name-attribute.md) | Flag the top-level `name` argument on `aws_db_instance`, removed in AWS provider v5. Use `db_name` with the same value. | error | aws | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-deprecated-lambda-runtime`](./no-deprecated-lambda-runtime.md) | Flag AWS-deprecated Lambda runtime identifiers on `aws_lambda_function` and `aws_lambda_layer_version` and name the nearest supported successor. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-eip-vpc-attribute`](./no-eip-vpc-attribute.md) | Flag the `vpc` argument on `aws_eip`, removed in AWS provider v6. Use `domain = "vpc"` (or omit `domain`). | error | aws | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-eks-addon-resolve-conflicts`](./no-eks-addon-resolve-conflicts.md) | Flag the `resolve_conflicts` argument on `aws_eks_addon`, removed in AWS provider v6. Use `resolve_conflicts_on_create` and `resolve_conflicts_on_update`. | error | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-hardcoded-provider-credentials`](./no-hardcoded-provider-credentials.md) | Flag literal `access_key`, `secret_key`, or `token` values in `provider "aws"` and s3 `backend` blocks, which leak credentials into source control. | error | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-iam-policy-attachment`](./no-iam-policy-attachment.md) | Flag `aws_iam_policy_attachment`, which manages a managed policy's attachments exclusively account-wide; prefer the non-exclusive per-principal attachment resources or the `*_policy_attachments_exclusive` resources. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-iam-role-inline-policies`](./no-iam-role-inline-policies.md) | Flag deprecated inline `inline_policy` blocks and the `managed_policy_arns` argument on `aws_iam_role`; prefer standalone `aws_iam_role_policy` / `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment` resources. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-instance-cpu-count-attributes`](./no-instance-cpu-count-attributes.md) | Flag `cpu_core_count` and `cpu_threads_per_core` on `aws_instance`, removed in AWS provider v6; move the values into a `cpu_options` block. | error | aws | ✔ | ✔ |
| [`no-legacy-security-group-rules`](./no-legacy-security-group-rules.md) | Flag legacy `aws_security_group_rule` resources and inline `ingress`/`egress` blocks; prefer `aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule` and `aws_vpc_security_group_egress_rule`. | error | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-mixed-security-group-rule-forms`](./no-mixed-security-group-rule-forms.md) | Warn when a standalone security group rule targets an `aws_security_group` that also defines inline `ingress`/`egress` blocks, which causes drift. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-pinned-minor-with-auto-upgrade`](./no-pinned-minor-with-auto-upgrade.md) | Flag AWS engine resources that pin `engine_version` deeper than an enabled `auto_minor_version_upgrade` will hold stable, which drifts on every plan. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-s3-bucket-inline-config`](./no-s3-bucket-inline-config.md) | Flag deprecated inline configuration on `aws_s3_bucket`; use the dedicated standalone `aws_s3_bucket_*` resources instead. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
| [`no-s3-bucket-object`](./no-s3-bucket-object.md) | Flag the deprecated `aws_s3_bucket_object` resource and data source and the `aws_s3_bucket_objects` data source; use `aws_s3_object` and `aws_s3_objects` instead. | warn | aws | ✔ |  |
